description: Common pedestrian-accessibility attribute set used to score coverage. Loosely aligned with the OpenSidewalks (OSW) schema and OpenStreetMap tagging so that heterogeneous local/state datasets can be crosswalked to one vocabulary.

attributes.label: Sidewalk network
attributes.description: Sidewalk geometry (centerlines or polygons) with enough topology to route on.

attributes.label: Crossings
attributes.description: Marked/unmarked crosswalk locations or crossing segments.

attributes.label: Curb ramps
attributes.description: Curb ramp / kerb presence and type at crossing ends.

attributes.label: Width
attributes.description: Clear path width of the sidewalk.

attributes.label: Tactile paving
attributes.description: Detectable warning surfaces at crossings and ramps.

attributes.label: Steps / stairs
attributes.description: Public stairs (barriers for wheelchair users; key in hilly cities).

attributes.label: Accessible ped. signals
attributes.description: Accessible pedestrian signals (audible/vibrotactile) at signalized crossings.
